title: 🧠 China Trains the Giant Xing 4 Model Without a Single Nvidia Card!
body: 🧠 China Trains the Giant Xing 4 Model Without a Single Nvidia Card!

The Xingchen General AI Lab of China Telecom published a technical report on the “Xing 4” model — a giant model with 285 billion parameters, of which 17 billion are active, using a mixture-of-experts architecture, trained entirely on 8,192 Huawei “Ascend 910C” neural processing units with the “MindSpore” platform, without any Nvidia card or CUDA platform. An open-weights version was also released, with 29 billion parameters of which 4 billion are active, a context ranging from 256,000 to one million tokens, and the model achieved a 4.68x gain in prefill speed — noting that these figures come from the authors and have not been independently reproduced yet.
Simply put: training a giant model was once exclusive to Nvidia cards; now a Chinese team has proven it is possible with fully local hardware.
Are chip restrictions changing the global AI map?
